acceptance: When the iostat child of the macOS host sampler exits or its stream ends, the sampler writes one diagnostic line naming the cause, once, and records keep omitting cpu_busy_pct.
A test drives a stream that ends and asserts the diagnostic.
fix: Thread an error sink through startCPUFeed and newSource so a dead iostat stream is reported, not silent.
source: code review r2 of ci-wall-time C13 part A, 2026-11-23
summary: The macOS host sampler reads CPU busy from one long-lived iostat child. When that child dies or its stream ends, records silently stop carrying cpu_busy_pct and nothing says why, so a CI run with no CPU data cannot be told apart from a host where iostat never started.
title: The host sampler reports a dead iostat stream
